C3 builds hazen 90th-percentile thresholds for day-of-year 138-259 using all 132 baseline days, then smooths them so every target day uses that full span. C4 compares the target SST with the thresholds per cell and finds the MHW runs, and C5 scatters the result to the grid and writes mhw_mask.nc."}
